fee_notes: Standard initial franchise fee is $1,000 per unit, paid in a lump sum at signing of the Franchise Agreement. Multi-unit franchisees pay $1,000 for each additional franchise agreement (2nd through 5th), all due at signing of the 1st FA. The fee is non-refundable under any circumstances. A separate refundable Booklet Security Deposit of $3,000 is also required at signing but is not part of the franchise fee itself.

Our standard initial fra nchise fee currently is $ 1,000. The initial franchise fee under the Franchise Agreement is not refundable under any circumstances.
